All 10 test features passed including stats cards, review list, AI response generation, publish response, all 7 nav buttons, platform filter (14 platforms), status filter, branding dialog, and integrations dialog (14 platforms).

issues: Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement recommended (existing issue from previous iteration)
